author: Michael Larabel
description: The eCryptfs stacked cryptographic filesystem implementation for the Linux kernel to transparently encrypt files saw a number of bug fixes for the Linux 7.3 kernel. A number of these bug fixes deal with potential maliciously-crafted data and vulnerable going back to the 2006 introduction of eCryptfs as this option known for its use on Ubuntu home directory encryption and Chrome OS...
title: eCryptfs Sees Fixes For Potential Malicious Intent, Some Dating Back To Its 2006 Debut

author: Michael Larabel
description: In early 2025 it was being discussed to potentially drop the HFS and HFS+ file-system support with the code having been orphaned over a decade and becoming a maintenance burden. But that dismal outlook quickly turned around with some developers stepping up to maintain the old Apple file-system support. Over a year later, fortunately, it's turned out to be a success story with more HFS/HFS+ file-system fixes continuing to work their way into the mainline Linux kernel...
title: Apple HFS / HFS+ File-System Support Continues Seeing Fixes With Linux 7.3

author: Michael Larabel
description: There is a changing of the guard with Linux 7.3 as the maintainer of the Common Internet File System (CIFS) / SMB3 code within the Linux kernel. Longtime maintainer, principal Linux CIFS author, and current Microsoft employee Steve French has stepped down due to health reasons...
title: Longtime Linux CIFS/SMB3 Maintainer Steps Down

author: Michael Larabel
description: A reported security vulnerability for the NTFS3 driver has gone unaddressed since being reported earlier this summer. The vulnerability allows a pre-crafted NTFS image on a USB flash drive or similar to allow the user to gain root access to the running Linux system...
title: Specially Crafted NTFS File-System Image Allows Root Access On Linux With NTFS3 Driver

author: Michael Larabel
description: The newest major feature to land in Mesa's open-source NVIDIA "NVK" Vulkan driver is support for Vulkan Video!..
title: NVK Vulkan Video Merged For Mesa 26.3

author: Michael Larabel
description: The extensible scheduler framework "sched_ext" that allows for custom schedulers as BPF programs has been working on sub-scheduler support in recent kernel cycles. With Linux 7.3, sub-scheduler support is now deemed feature complete...
title: Sched_ext's Sub-Scheduler Support Now "Feature Complete" With Linux 7.3

author: Michael Larabel
description: Tuned 2.28 released this Saturday as the newest version of Red Hat's tuning profile delivery mechanism for Linux. Tuned is used notably out-of-the-box on Fedora Linux for monitoring and adaptively tuning systems...
title: Red Hat's Tuned 2.28 To Improve Out-Of-The-Box WiFi Power Savings On Fedora

author: Michael Larabel
description: The open-source, reverse-engineered Etnaviv driver stack that began for providing accelerated graphics support on Vivante GPU IP and since expanded to handle Vivante NPUs as well is now able to handle YOLOX object detection...
title: Open-Source Etnaviv Driver Now Able To Run YOLOX

author: Michael Larabel
description: The highlight of this week's x86/mm pull request of changes for the Linux 7.3 kernel are fixes that reduce the time that the TLB flushing code has interrupts disabled. This helps significantly with latency-sensitive workloads but Intel engineer Dave Hansen noted in the pull request that "it's certainly something to keep an eye on" in looking out for any regressions...
title: Linux 7.3 x86/mm Lands Patches To Greatly Improve Latency-Sensitive Workloads
